title: docs(sprints): register MAINT-DEFER-015/016 — scaffolder cp1252 preview defect and Helmholtz L_eff defect
intent: Record two real but non-blocking defects in the DEFERRED MAINTENANCE queue so neither is carried only in session memory. MAINT-DEFER-015: scripts/scaffold_agents_md.py --dry-run exits 1 with UnicodeEncodeError on a cp1252 console because the AGENTS.md template's comment fences use U+2500; the write path is unaffected (explicit encoding="utf-8") and was verified by scaffolding an external repo, so only the preview mode breaks. MAINT-DEFER-016: acoustic_body_volume.py:220 applies the end-correction coefficient to the plate-thickness term as well as the aperture-radius term, unlike the canonical soundhole_calc.py form, changing the effective neck length and therefore the Helmholtz estimate. Registration only — NEITHER defect is implemented here, and no source file is touched.
